title: 甩繩的人
subject: the rope-turner on a junior-high double-dutch team at the county championship who has turned the ropes for three years without ever jumping, until the coach swaps her in for the last freestyle routine and her best friend turns for her
caption: Mandarin Jersey club, a bouncy Newark-style club track. Drum-machine kicks firing in rapid triplet rolls and the syncopated Jersey bounce pattern, a dry bed-squeak percussion loop, sharp handclaps on every beat, bright synth pluck chords looping over four bars, and a round sub bass locked to the kick. Dry, punchy club mix with a short gym-hall slap delay on the claps. Female voice, a bright young alto, quick rhythmic chant-singing in the verses, with a group of girls shouting back the two-word rope call in the chorus. 140 BPM, B-flat minor. Breathless, sporty and cheeky. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM build-up or drop, no UK garage shuffle, no sampled voice snippets.
lyrics:
[Intro - triplet kick rolls and bed-squeak loop]

[Verse 1]
禮拜六早上八點 縣立體育館
小芸的鞋帶 綁了又拆 拆了又綁
我跟阿凱 一人握兩條繩
三年了 我只負責甩

[Pre-Chorus]
裁判按下碼錶
我小聲數 一 二 一 二

[Chorus - Lead and Group Shouts]
進繩 進繩 繩子打地板 啪 啪 啪
手不要停 腳不要停
她在中間跳 大家都看她
我在旁邊甩 我只看她的腳

[Verse 2]
速度賽 裁判按著計數器 喀喀喀
第三十秒 她腳尖勾到繩
看台上 整排一起 喔了一聲
我再甩起來 兩拍以後 她又跳進來

[Chorus - Lead and Group Shouts]
進繩 進繩 斷一下 沒關係
手不要停 腳不要停
她在中間跳 偷偷回頭看我
我在旁邊甩 甩得再穩一點

[Bridge - kicks drop out, claps only]
最後一段花式 教練對我招手
換我進去 換小芸來甩

[Chorus - Lead and Group Shouts]
進繩 進繩 三年來第一次跳
手不要停 腳不要停
小芸在旁邊甩 她只看我的腳
原來從中間看 繩子轉得這麼快

[Outro - bed-squeak loop and claps fading]
